_comment: Copy to waterfall_config.json (gitignored) and tune to YOUR ICP. Technology UIDs must be valid Apollo UIDs -- verify one first: apollo companies search --technology <uid> --per-page 1. Funding is an amount proxy for round stage (the API has no stage filter). Optional per-gate 'cap' limits how many companies one gate may contribute -- without caps, a deep gate with thousands of matches fills the whole list and the shallower gates never fire.

exclude._comment: NAICS prefixes to drop. 5613 = staffing/recruiting (they post jobs FOR clients, the classic job-posting-gate false positive), 541612 = HR consulting.
